canonical_example.text: Se reportaron inesperadas ganancias al cierre del año fiscal.
canonical_example.translation: Unexpected profits were reported at the end of the tax year.

canonical_example.text: El joyero tiene un cierre dorado.
canonical_example.translation: The jewel box has a golden clasp.

canonical_example.text: No puedo bajar el cierre de esta falda.
canonical_example.translation: I can't undo the zip on this skirt.

canonical_example.text: A consecuencia del robo, instalaron un cierre metálico en la tienda.
canonical_example.translation: After the robbery, a metal shutter was installed in the store.

canonical_example.text: Cierra herméticamente el tarro.
canonical_example.translation: Close the jar tightly.

canonical_example.text: Puedes cerrar el gas en la válvula de cierre principal.
canonical_example.translation: ​You can turn the gas off at the main shut-off valve.

canonical_example.text: Cierra la luz y vete a dormir.
canonical_example.translation: Turn off the light and go to sleep.

canonical_example.text: Tuvimos que cerrar el negocio porque no era rentable.
canonical_example.translation: We had to close the business because it wasn't profitable.

canonical_example.text: ¿Crees que acabarán cerrando la discoteca?
canonical_example.translation: Do you think they'll end up shutting down the nightclub?

canonical_example.text: ¿Sabes a qué hora cierra la tienda?
canonical_example.translation: Do you know what time the store closes?

canonical_example.text: Cerramos a las 8 pm.
canonical_example.translation: We shut at 8 pm.

canonical_example.text: La mayoría de las cortaduras pequeñas cierran rápidamente.
canonical_example.translation: Most minor cuts heal quickly.

canonical_example.text: Me corté la mano pero la herida ya cerró.
canonical_example.translation: I cut my hand, but the wound already closed up.

canonical_example.text: No sabía que ese restaurante había cerrado.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't know that restaurant had closed.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuándo cerró la fábrica?
canonical_example.translation: When did the factory shut down?

canonical_example.text: No me cierro a nuevas oportunidades.
canonical_example.translation: I'm not closed to new opportunities.

source_metadata.context: to refuse to change; used with "a"

canonical_example.text: El cielo se está cerrando. Espero que no llueva.
canonical_example.translation: The sky is becoming overcast. I hope it doesn't rain.

canonical_example.text: El sol se pone y se cierra la noche.
canonical_example.translation: The sun sets and night falls.

canonical_example.text: Ciérrate la chaqueta que hace frío.
canonical_example.translation: Zip up your jacket; it's cold.

canonical_example.text: La herida no se cierra sola y por eso hay que suturarla.
canonical_example.translation: The wound isn't healing on its own so we'll need to stitch it up.

canonical_example.text: Cada vez que se lo comento, se cierra y cambia de tema.
canonical_example.translation: Every time I mention it to her, she shuts down and changes the subject.

canonical_example.text: The moral of the story is that you should never lie.
canonical_example.translation: La moraleja del cuento es que nunca debes mentir.

canonical_example.text: I don't think you're in any position to make moral judgments.
canonical_example.translation: No creo que seas la persona más indicada para hacer juicios morales.

canonical_example.text: Frances is a moral woman. She would never betray me.
canonical_example.translation: Frances es una persona moral. Nunca me traicionaría.

canonical_example.text: We teach Christian morals in our school.
canonical_example.translation: En nuestra escuela enseñamos la moral cristiana.

canonical_example.text: The newspaper has started a debate on morals in public life.
canonical_example.translation: El periódico ha iniciado un debate sobre la moralidad en la vida pública.

canonical_example.text: Pareces cansado. ¿Dormiste bien anoche?
canonical_example.translation: You seem tired. Did you sleep well last night?

canonical_example.text: Pareces triste. ¿Qué pasó?
canonical_example.translation: You look sad. What happened?

canonical_example.text: Mi perro parece un zorro con su cola tan larga.
canonical_example.translation: My dog looks like a fox with his long tail.

sense_provider_metadata.context: to have a physical similarity to

canonical_example.text: Te pareces mucho a tu papá cuando tenía tu edad.
canonical_example.translation: You look a lot like your father when he was your age.

canonical_example.text: Pareces tener mucha hambre.
canonical_example.translation: You seem to be very hungry.

canonical_example.text: Parece que va a nevar. - No creo; no está lo suficientemente frío.
canonical_example.translation: It looks like it's going to snow. - I don't think so; it's not cold enough.

canonical_example.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
canonical_example.translation: I think the minister should resign.

canonical_example.text: Tu parecer es distinto al mío.
canonical_example.translation: Your opinion is different from mine.

canonical_example.text: Se parece a un vaquero con esas botas y esa actitud.
canonical_example.translation: He's like a cowboy with those boots and that attitude.

canonical_example.text: No nos parecemos pero somos hermanos.
canonical_example.translation: We don't look alike, but we are brothers.

canonical_example.text: El dictador fue enterrado en un lugar secreto para evitar el vandalismo.
canonical_example.translation: The dictator was buried in a secret location to prevent vandalism.

canonical_example.text: Si te cuento un secreto, ¿prometes no revelárselo a nadie?
canonical_example.translation: If I tell you a secret, do you promise to keep it?

canonical_example.text: Perdiste muchísimo peso en los últimos seis meses. ¿Cuál es tu secreto?
canonical_example.translation: You lost so much weight in the last six months. What's your secret?

canonical_example.text: Se reunían en secreto porque no querían que nadie los viera juntos.
canonical_example.translation: They met in secret because they didn't want to be seen together.

canonical_example.text: Dijo que había dejado el cigarrillo, pero descubrimos que seguía fumando en secreto.
canonical_example.translation: She told us she quit smoking, but we found out she continued smoking in secrecy.

canonical_example.text: "Déjanos," le dijo el rey a su chambelán cuando entró la reina.
canonical_example.translation: "Leave us," said the king to his chamberlain when the queen came in.

canonical_example.text: Por favor, papi. Déjanos ir. Te prometemos portarnos bien.
canonical_example.translation: Please, Daddy. Let us go. We promise we'll behave.
